title: Phoenix Ghost Tour: Phoenix Screamix
blurb:
Think you know Phoenix? Think again.
This isn’t just a ghost tour—it’s a hands-on paranormal investigation through the most famous haunted locations in downtown Phoenix.

You won’t just hear the stories… you’ll test them. Guests use real ghost hunting equipment like EMF detectors and spirit boxes to interact with the spirits said to haunt places like Hotel San Carlos and the Orpheum Theatre.

We’re locally owned, not a scripted franchise—every story is rooted in real Phoenix history, real research, and real experiences.
